name: HSP / VetHUB Compliance Automation Tool
highlights: Built and shipped an automation tool that generates audit-ready HUB Subcontracting Plan (HSP) packets for Texas public-sector construction bids, delivered to a first paying client through my company, Renvane AI.

Engineered a pipeline that scrapes the Texas CMBL/VetHUB vendor site by trade/NIGP code, verifies vendor business descriptions and active certifications, prioritizes vendors nearest Austin, and exports up to 3 approved vendor-evidence PDFs per code as an organized zip with duplicate detection.
Reduced a ~8-hour manual HSP packet process to ~30–60 minutes (~7 hours saved per bid; ~$2,100/month recovered value at client volume).
Added automated re-checking to catch expiring certifications, and authored a PRD, V2 plan, and web-frontend roadmap (public web app, Slack integration, vendor-PDF database, search history).

name: Afri Outreach Automation — Multi-Agent B2B Outreach Pipeline
highlights: Designed a multi-agent AI pipeline (research → drafting → copy-polish agents) that generates personalized B2B email and WhatsApp outreach for Afri Investment, targeting East African infrastructure prospects with a human review gate before any send.
Modeled a Supabase (Postgres) schema (subsidiaries → companies → contacts) with pgvector(1536) research embeddings and an internal knowledge-base table for positioning.

Implemented human-in-the-loop approval via Gmail drafts and a Telegram bot, with state tracking/deduplication against in-flight conversations, dated run-output folders, and cron polling every 10–15 minutes for new companies.
Drafted outreach across 24+ prospects (South Sudan, Somalia, Somaliland) as part of a 343+ prospect database.

name: OpenClaw — Personal Multi-Agent AI System
highlights: Architected a self-hosted 5-agent personal AI system with explicit per-agent model assignments and tool allowlists (main/coder, calendar, summarizer, outreach), operating across messaging platforms.
Consolidated the system from 6 to 5 agents, sandboxed the coder agent, and configured per-use-case model fallback chains across Codex, GLM, Kimi, and DeepSeek via OpenRouter.
Runs native cron jobs, sub-agent delegation, per-thread model assignment, and scheduled daily priority reminders.

name: ToneTrace — Intelligent Writing Analytics for Educators
highlights: Built a modular FastAPI backend to analyze text for tone, sentiment, formality, and passive voice using HuggingFace transformers for multi-label emotion classification.
Designed analyzers for lexical diversity and writing complexity, with a scalable architecture supporting future LLM-based personalization and anomaly detection.
Integrated PostgreSQL to store per-user writing history, enabling fingerprinting and graph-based insights on tone/style trends over time.
Automated Docker workflows with Bash/Shell for containerization, image optimization, and service orchestration, improving deployment speed and reliability; built on Linux.
Advancing ToneTrace into an educational platform to improve quality of education for students learning writing and language. Live app: https://tonetrace.vercel.app/

name: Quantitative Trading Research — ETH/USDT Momentum Strategies
highlights: Investigated whether hourly momentum is a real effect in ETH using 8 years of data with walk-forward validation (365d train / 90d test, frozen parameters, rolling forward).
Identified consistent signal strength: optimal windows clustered in the 14–24h range ~78% of the time across all periods, suggesting non-random structure rather than curve-fit noise.
Built a pandas backtest engine with 1-bar execution delay and 0.13% per-side cost model, clipped by an EMA50/200 trend filter.

Final strategy remained profitable post-costs but did not outperform buy-and-hold on a risk-adjusted basis: Strategy AR 29.5%, Sharpe 0.72, Calmar 0.32, Max DD 93.1%; Buy-and-Hold AR 31.1%, Sharpe 0.75, Calmar 0.33, Max DD 94.3%.

Risk controls improved realism (trade count 69,351 → 2,722 with a 24h min-hold) but the system still suffered catastrophic drawdowns and needs volatility targeting / position throttling before live use.
Concluded that ETH momentum is real at the 14–24h horizon, but without advanced risk systems it is not economically superior to passive exposure despite being directionally profitable.

name: Solo Leveling-Inspired Self-Improvement Web App
highlights: Engineered a full-stack RPG-style self-improvement platform enabling users to set quests, track XP, and level up attributes such as Discipline, Strength, and Mindfulness.
Integrated Firebase Authentication for secure user management and persistent per-user quest and progress data.
Designed modular React components for quest management, XP tracking, and a responsive dark-themed dashboard UI using Tailwind CSS.

Structured real-time data storage with Firestore, enabling efficient retrieval of user quests, XP history, and profile information across devices. Live app: https://solo-leveling-real-life.vercel.app/
